snippet.title: Catch The Train | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
I've been working on a side project for a while and it finally has a trailer!
Wishlist it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1862300/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer_sep2026

It's called Catch The Train. You and up to five friends crew a steam train, cook for very hungry penguins, shovel coal, throw switches, and try to outrun a storm that will end your run. Someone always gets left behind. It's usually me.

Demo out on October 7th on the same page. Grab some friends, it's way funnier with voice chat.

1 to 6 players, online co-op.

Thanks for watching, and if you play it, tell me what broke.
